title: Mystic Apothecary Consultation
description: A vibrant fantasy scene inside a purple-walled apothecary filled with hanging glowing lanterns, potion bottles, and framed magical symbols including a green snake and red flames. A blue-skinned sorceress with a peacock headdress stands behind a counter gesturing toward an open glowing red book, speaking to a hooded figure with glowing blue eyes, while a small red-clad child with green hair reaches up from a stool.
prompt: Detailed fantasy illustration of a mystical apothecary interior with purple walls covered in framed arcane symbols like a green ouroboros and red flame emblems. A blue-skinned female sorcerer with elaborate green peacock headdress and purple robes stands behind a counter, gesturing toward an ancient glowing red book. A mysterious hooded figure with glowing blue eyes listens intently. In the foreground a small child with bright green braided hair in a red tunic stands on a stool reaching upward. The scene is filled with hanging colorful glass lanterns, potion bottles, scrolls, and herbs.
